# Mercovia

> Mercovia is a multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace where independent
> sellers list products and events and buyers browse, purchase, and
> track orders across multiple shops in a single checkout.

Mercovia is a live production application. Product and event pages are
server-rendered and safe to fetch directly; prices are in USD and stock
levels reflect real-time inventory.

## Key pages
- [Home](/): featured products, categories, and active events
- [All products](/products): full catalog with search, category, and price filters
- [Best selling](/best-selling): top-selling products
- [Events](/events): time-limited seller promotions
- [Individual product pages](/product/{id}): name, description, price, stock, seller, and reviews
- [Individual event pages](/events/{id}): event details, countdown, price, and stock
- [Shop pages](/shop/preview/{id}): seller profile, products, and active events

## Notes for agents and crawlers
- robots.txt: /robots.txt
- sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Product and event detail pages include JSON-LD (schema.org Product) in
  the initial server-rendered HTML.
- Checkout, account, inbox, and order pages require an authenticated
  session and are excluded from crawling via robots.txt.
- Prices and stock are authoritative from the server at request time;
  do not assume cached values remain valid for purchase decisions.
